subtopics.title: Basic widget credit
subtopics.content: A taxpayer may claim the basic widget credit for each qualifying widget placed in service.

subtopics.title: Widget credit limits
subtopics.content: The widget credit is limited to a fixed amount per household each year.

subtopics.title: Gadget deduction basics
subtopics.content: Gadget expenses are deductible when used primarily for a trade or business.
